# Round Funded

> Investor database and matching for founders. Pre-seed to Series C. 60,000+ investors.

- Product: https://roundfunded.com
- Matching: https://roundfunded.com/en/tools/investor-match
- Positioning: Fundraising is super easy.
- Investors: 60,000+ active angels and VCs
- Coverage: 40+ industries, 60+ countries
- Features: stage/sector matching, data room, outreach, pipeline
- Not: a fund, an accelerator, or a partner of Y Combinator / Antler / Techstars / 500 Global
- Repo: https://github.com/roundfunded/roundfunded
